scenarios.requirement: An option value reads back byte for byte after it is written, whatever bytes it holds, and the codec reads no byte outside the value and writes none outside its buffer; a hand-written backslash r is a carriage return and a trailing or stray backslash is a backslash
scenarios.note: pass A; seeded property over 4000 random byte strings of 0 to 600 bytes plus the evidence inputs; also run under ASan and UBSan; red when the carriage return case, the trailing backslash rule or the +1 of the computed size is dropped (measured on scratch copies of we_optval.c)

scenarios.requirement: A MessageString that ends in a backslash, read after a long option line, is saved as written with no leftover bytes
A folder xwperc with a 254-byte MessageString of three line breaks starts the editor with no memory report
A hand-written backslash r in a MessageString is read as a carriage return and saved as that byte
An empty MessageString does not leave the option file at 0 bytes at quit
A MessageString made only of escapes does not leave the option file at 0 bytes at quit and reads back the same
Options > Compiler opens on an empty MessageString with no memory report
A full Message-String field ending in two line breaks is taken by OK with no memory report
The reader of an option file frees the open section's name at the end of the file and after a line it cannot place; leak report names no frame of the reader
scenarios.note: run as wpe-asan with leak detection on; red on f2305d3 through the 11-byte section

scenarios.requirement: The same after a line with no colon
An unclosed header followed by an option line causes no memory error and no leak in the reader
scenarios.note: guard of the continue-reading path (the section pointer is cleared with the memory); not red on f2305d3, which stopped at that header

scenarios.requirement: The error box names the first unreadable line and the file, and the settings after it are read
The quit-time save does not rewrite an option file that had an unreadable line
The lines under an unclosed header are passed over without being counted, and the next good header is read
Control: a well-formed file gets no box and is saved at quit
The box shows a short file name whole and says the options are not saved at quit while the file has an unreadable line
A line with a NUL byte is refused by its number and does not join the line after it
The 1.6 keyboard profile rewrite at start leaves an option file with an unreadable line as it is
After Options > Save has written the file whole, the quit-time save writes again
The graphical editor boxes an unreadable option line, closes the box on OK and leaves the file as written at quit
scenarios.note: parity smoke row; the box text is asserted by the terminal rows

scenarios.requirement: The same on the native Wayland editor
Options > Compiler opens on an empty MessageString in the graphical editor
scenarios.note: parity smoke row, not a guard on a plain build; a guard on a sanitizer xwpe

scenarios.requirement: Options > Compiler opens on an empty MessageString in the native Wayland editor
scenarios.note: parity smoke row, as the x11 twin
